A '''caretaker droid''' was a position a [[droid]] could hold. The [[unidentified Iokath species]] made their own [[Caretaker droid (Iokath)|caretaker droids]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref> [[4A-7/Legends|4A-7]] falsely claimed to be a caretaker droid during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] before his true loyalty to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] was discovered.<ref name="The Clone Wars" />
